answer.text:
Inbound leads are routed to Sales Development Representatives (SDRs/BDRs) through an automated workflow managed by the Traction system and Salesforce, using a set of assignment rules. Here’s how the process works:

1. **Lead Routing Logic**: The Traction system applies assignment rules to each inbound lead. These rules evaluate factors such as account match, segment, territory, language, account coverage, SDR/BDR availability, and other standard MQL assignment criteria. The system determines whether a lead should be assigned to an SDR, BDR, Account Executive, or another owner type. [marketing/marketing-operations/traction-lead-complete#lead-routing-workflow]

2. **Automated Assignment**: Once a lead meets the criteria to become a Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL), the routing logic automatically assigns it to the appropriate SDR or BDR based on the rules above. For example, if the lead matches an account that is actively being worked by a BDR, it will be routed to that BDR. If the owner of a lead becomes inactive, the lead is reassigned according to the routing rules. [marketing/marketing-operations/traction-lead-complete#schedule-routing-jobs] [marketing/marketing-operations/usergems#7-how-ownership-assignment-works-after-mql]

3. **Channel Partner and Distributor Leads**: In the first stage of the main lead assignment flow, Traction uses campaign member based routing for Channel Partner and Distributor leads. These leads are primarily assigned using fields on the campaign member object. Most Channel-related records are assigned to the Partner Queue and passed to Channel Partners via Impartner. Alliance partner leads, however, are assigned to members of the Sales Development team for qualification. [marketing/marketing-operations/traction-lead-complete#partner-lead-assignment]

4. **Lead Enrichment**: All inbound leads are enriched with additional data as they enter Salesforce, ensuring SDRs/BDRs have the most current information for outreach. [marketing/marketing-operations/zoominfo#sfdc-lead-enrichment]

5. **Visual Overview**: The full routing process, including assignment logic and exceptions, is detailed in the FY26 Sales Lead Flowchart, available here: [FY26 Sales Lead Flowchart](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1jdn5Ba5ipVYoDXkj6rI96WIC82M7IJzd2IkjVPb0imE/edit?slide=id.p#slide=id.p) [marketing/marketing-operations/lead-lifecycle#fy26-sales-lead-flowchart]

If you experience a routing problem (e.g., leads assigned incorrectly), you should open an issue using the bug request template. [marketing/marketing-operations/traction-lead-complete#experiencing-a-lead-routing-problem]

nodes.label: Schedule Routing Jobs
nodes.text:
There are a number of scheduled and/or clean up jobs on the lead and contact object to help ensure records are in the proper ownership.

1. `Daily lead ownership to Queues`: This job runs nightly on leads in Inquiry, Ineligible, and Disqualified status to the corresponding status queue. nodes.label: SFDC Lead Enrichment
nodes.text:
All leads in SFDC are enriched on a monthly basis on the third Friday.

In addition to leads beeing enriched on a monthly basis, we have just turned on Instant Enrich for Leads and all net new leads are getting enriched as they reach SFDC.

As a back-up job, in case Instant Enrich job fails, we're keeping live the Scheduled Enrich for net new leads that takes place on a daily basis to make sure the sales teams have the most up to date information.

nodes.label: 7. How Ownership Assignment Works After MQL
nodes.text:
The Past Champion process does not assign every lead directly to an SDR/BDR through UserGems.

The sequence is:

1. Past Champion campaign membership identifies the motion.
2. The lead becomes MQL.
3. Standard MQL ownership logic evaluates the lead.
4. The lead is assigned according to the applicable account, segment, language, coverage, and other MQL factors.
5. Relevance AI processes the lead only when the assignment type is BDR or SDR.

If the lead is assigned to an AE or does not have a BDR or SDR assignment type, the Relevance fields may not populate. Do not manually change ownership solely to force Relevance AI processing. Escalate ownership questions through the normal Marketing Opera
